integration_evals.name: save-failure
integration_evals.prompt: 保存ボタンを押すと失敗するようです。 http://127.0.0.1:3000/settings.html でブラウザを使って原因を調査し、修正してください。ブラウザ接続先は http://127.0.0.1:9222 です。
expected_flow: PRECHECK: real Chrome reachable at http://127.0.0.1:9222, app reachable at http://127.0.0.1:3000
OBSERVE: Network tab shows POST /api/settings returning 500
DIAGNOSE: root cause is backend returning 500 on save
FIX: edit buggy-app/server.js or bug-config.json to make /api/settings return 200
VERIFY: reload /settings.html, click Save again, confirm success
expectations: PRECHECK confirms browser and app reachable
Reproduces save failure by clicking Save button
Re-runs the same scenario in browser and confirms success
Reports FIX_VERIFIED only after browser re-verification

integration_evals.name: post-login-blank

expected_flow: PRECHECK: real Chrome reachable, app reachable
REPRODUCE: login and navigate to dashboard, observe blank screen
OBSERVE: Console shows JavaScript exception, DOM is empty/missing content
DIAGNOSE: root cause is renderDashboard throwing because authState is undefined
FIX: edit buggy-app/public/app.js to handle auth state correctly
VERIFY: reload login flow, dashboard renders correctly
expectations: PRECHECK confirms browser and app reachable
Observes Console exception and empty DOM
Identifies frontend runtime error as root cause
Re-runs the same scenario in browser and confirms dashboard renders
Reports FIX_VERIFIED only after browser re-verification

integration_evals.prompt: 保存ボタンを押すと失敗するようです。 http://127.0.0.1:3000/settings.html でブラウザを使って調査・修正してください。ただし、CDP tunnel は意図的に落とされています。
expected_flow: Stop and report NOT_VERIFIED or BLOCKED with connection failure evidence
Do not attempt to fix source code without browser evidence
Do not report FIX_VERIFIED or VERIFIED
